Turnkey · Pune

Mocha

A café and lounge in Pune where layered stone walls, glowing copper lights and indoor gardens turn a dining room into a landscape.

Location
Pune
Venue
Café & lounge
Scope
Turnkey: design & execution
Spaces
Atrium, gardens & window lounge
The project

A canyon of light, stone and green.

The walls rise in sculpted, stepped layers like eroded rock, wrapping the room in warm texture and turning every corner into a nook.

Clusters of copper-toned pendants hang beneath a glass skylight, while indoor gardens, boulders and oversized clay urns bring the outdoors inside. After dark the room glows like a lantern above the city.

Inside Mocha

Space by space

The atrium

Copper chandeliers gather beneath the skylight over a planted island, with deep booths and timber tables arranged around the greenery.

Gardens and boulders

Lush planting, rocks and sculpted ledges blur the line between dining room and garden, softening the scale of the space.

The urn lounge

Giant clay urns become sculpture above a relaxed lounge of round tables and low armchairs, framed by the layered walls.

The window lounge

Along the glass, woven pendants and warm table lamps light intimate seating with a view out over the city at night.
